full_text:
The Amazonian second-in-command is second only to Queen Hippolyta in the Amazon nation. Her actual name is thus far unknown.

==History==
When she and the other Amazons attacked the Huntik Foundation, she was able to hold her ground against Sophie Casterwill. Later, the second-in-command was injured by a Bonelasher while defending Queen Hippolyta. After the confrontation with the Organization, she began recovery with a sling on her arm. [Ladies' Choice]

==Personality==
She is fierce but loyal to her queen. Though initially The Amazonian, however, became very friendly to Sophie upon discovering that she was a Seeker like Hippolyta. [Ladies' Choice]

==Abilities==
She has great warrior skills and can get along in a fight with spears and bows. She is the second strongest of the village behind Hippolyta only due to Hippolyta's powers as a Seeker. Despite not being a Seeker, the second-in-command was even capable of holding her ground against Sophie Casterwill. [Ladies' Choice]
